data.title: bn-2vih: adapt rebaseline runner to protocol v4 (findings addressed)
data.description: Amended after cr-1e7dil review. Fixes all three findings: (F1 rehearsal laundering) evaluator forces rehearsal->INCONCLUSIVE, terminal verifier rejects any rehearsal result/provenance, new hostile case v4-rehearsal-evidence-cannot-admit; (F2 DECLARED.txt) strict label=<sha256> line parse, single-link regular-file only (no symlink/hardlink), exact per-variant digest binding, frozen into provenance+frozen_files against post-admission edits, +3 hostile cases (embedded-token, negating-comment, symlink); (F3 claim residue) removed v3 claims-layout reads in _verify_prepared_input_metadata + _prepared_tree_state, write_failure records run_claim_path. 4 files: run_rebaseline.py, evidence_schema.py, evaluate.py, verify_terminal.py. All self-tests green: runner 163/163, evaluator 311/311, verifier 187/187, semantic-authority; fmt clean. Commit 615e8e57 tree 98b3b481.
